scope_note: This validates representational adequacy of the canonical grammar contract across six chapter types. It does not claim the six learner lessons are already CONTENT_COMPLETE and does not pass Stage 2 for the full 168-chapter dataset.

checks.evidence: All six pilots retain source chapter IDs while mapping to semantic concept IDs.
CONJUGATION pattern plus form-building exercise types represent person/number endings and stem-ending variants without chapter-specific schema fields.
CASE_MATRIX and TRANSFORMATION patterns represent Wo+Dativ/Wohin+Akkusativ and contractions.
WORD_ORDER plus DECLENSION patterns represent verb-final structure, antecedent agreement and relative-pronoun behavior without over-merging later case concepts.
WORD_ORDER and CONNECTOR_POSITION patterns represent position fields, Satzklammer, postfield and verb-first sentence types.
TENSE_FORMATION plus TRANSFORMATION represents the multi-tense passive matrix and von/durch/mit complement distinctions.
TRANSFORMATION and DECLENSION patterns represent argument remapping, prepositional complements and connector-to-preposition conversion.
Pilot requirements use both currently supported and richer canonical exercise types (for example ORDER_SENTENCE, TRANSFORM_SENTENCE, CASE_SELECTION and FORM_BUILDING) without dropping them.
Printed-page and verification-copy PDF locators can be represented. Exact manifest-byte source authority remains separately preserved and must not be conflated with current verification-copy hashes.

The contract has separate German explanation and Persian support fields at lesson/rule/error level; no additional field is required by the six pilot structures. Learner-facing bilingual content is produced downstream.
None of the six pilots required a one-off chapter-specific field outside the contract object model.

decision: The draft grammar content contract is adequate for mass canonicalization of source chapters and semantic concept identities. Keep the contract version at v1.0.0 for this production run; do not weaken it to current runtime fields.
next_action: Create the full 168-chapter canonical source-chapter layer and semantic concept registry, applying explicit deduplication decisions before Stage 2 validation.
